recheck.text: What legalMoves, applyMove and status do when the FEN argument is missing, not a string, malformed (empty, wrong number of ranks or squares in a rank, unknown piece letter, bad side-to-move or other field, trailing whitespace or newline) or syntactically valid but an impossible position (a side with no king or two kings, a pawn on the first or eighth rank, the side not to move already in check).

defects.title: FEN with the wrong number of ranks is accepted and answered as if valid
defects.repro: const c=require('./src/chess.js'); const f='rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP w KQkq - 0 1'; c.legalMoves(f); c.status(f); c.applyMove(f,'e2e4')
defects.observed: 16 moves, 'ongoing', and 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/8 b KQkq e3 0 1' (an empty eighth-from-top rank invented)
defects.expected: A thrown descriptive error (Error, TypeError, invalid-FEN class or IllegalMoveError) from all three functions

defects.title: Invalid side-to-move field reported as stalemate
defects.repro: const c=require('./src/chess.js'); const f='rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR x KQkq - 0 1'; c.status(f); c.legalMoves(f)
defects.expected: A thrown error for the invalid 'x' field, not a game result

defects.title: Unknown piece letters, over-long ranks and bad castling fields pass through into returned FENs; the three functions disagree
defects.repro: const c=require('./src/chess.js'); c.applyMove('rnbqkbnr/ppppxppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1','e2e4'); const g='rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/9/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1'; c.legalMoves(g); c.status(g); c.applyMove(g,'e2e4'); c.applyMove('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w XYZ - 0 1','e2e4')
defects.observed: 'rnbqkbnr/ppppxppp/8/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq e3 0 1'; for g legalMoves throws TypeError 'PIECE_STEPS[type] is not iterable' while status returns 'ongoing' and applyMove returns 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/97/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq e3 0 1'; the XYZ field is echoed as '... b XYZ e3 0 1'
defects.expected: A consistent thrown error for each malformed FEN

defects.title: An invalid side-to-move field is reported as stalemate
defects.repro: const c=require('./src/chess.js'); c.status('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR x KQkq - 0 1'); c.legalMoves(same); also with 'W' instead of 'w'
defects.expected: An error saying the FEN is invalid (or the side read case-insensitively), not a confident 'stalemate' for a malformed FEN

defects.title: Malformed piece placement and castling fields are accepted and echoed into the returned FEN
defects.repro: c.applyMove('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/9/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1','e2e4'); c.applyMove('rnbqkbnr/ppppxppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1','e2e4'); c.applyMove('rnbqkbnr/ppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1','e2e4'); c.applyMove('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w XYZ - 0 1','e2e4'); c.legalMoves('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1')
defects.observed: Returned '.../97/...', '.../ppppxppp/...', '.../ppppppp1/...' (missing square silently filled), '... b XYZ e3 0 1'; the 9-rank FEN returns ['a1a2','b1b2',...] as if valid
defects.expected: An error naming the malformed FEN rather than a confident result or a corrupted FEN

defects.title: Missing or garbled FEN fails with internal TypeErrors, inconsistent across functions
defects.repro: c.legalMoves(''); c.legalMoves('not-a-fen'); c.status(undefined); c.legalMoves('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq -'); c.applyMove()
defects.observed: TypeError 'ranks[rank] is not iterable'; TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')"; TypeError 'Cannot convert undefined to a BigInt'; but applyMove() throws IllegalMoveError 'Expected a legal UCI move string'
defects.expected: A descriptive invalid-FEN error, the same kind from all three functions
